tools.name: magpie_loan_quote
tools.description: Calculate a single-tier Magpie loan quote. Given a collateral value in USD and a tier (Express / Quick / Standard), returns: SOL received net of fee, gross SOL loan, fee in SOL, total repayment in SOL, term in days, LTV%, and approximate liquidation drop %. Use when the user wants a quote for ONE specific tier. If you don't know which tier they want, use magpie_compare_tiers instead to show all three.

collateral_usd.description: The dollar value of the memecoin or tokenized stock collateral being pledged. Must be positive.

tier.description: Magpie loan tier. Express = 30% LTV, 2 days, 3% fee (highest payout). Quick = 25% LTV, 3 days, 2% fee (balanced). Standard = 20% LTV, 7 days, 1.5% fee (lowest fee, most headroom).

sol_price_usd.description: Optional SOL price in USD. If omitted, the handler fetches the live price from DexScreener. Pass it explicitly for deterministic outputs.

tools.name: magpie_compare_tiers
tools.description: Compare all three Magpie loan tiers (Express, Quick, Standard) side-by-side for a single collateral value. Returns a structured array with the SOL received, fee, and liquidation buffer for each tier, plus a recommendation summary. Use when the user wants to choose between tiers, or when no tier is specified.

collateral_usd.description: The dollar value of the collateral being pledged. Must be positive.

sol_price_usd.description: Optional SOL price in USD. If omitted, fetched live from DexScreener.

tools.name: magpie_open_loan_link
tools.description: Return a t.me/magpie_capital_bot deep-link the user can tap to open Magpie's Telegram loan bot with our referrer code attached. Loans are non-custodial and execute on-chain — Magpie's bot walks the user through wallet connection, collateral selection, and signing. Call this AFTER the user has decided to actually take a loan (e.g. they have already received a quote and confirmed they want to proceed). Returns the deep-link URL, the suggested tier, and a recap of the quote so the user knows what to pick inside the bot. Tier and collateral are inputs only for the recap; the bot itself prompts for them again because the /start parameter only carries the referrer code.

collateral_usd.description: Optional dollar value of the collateral the user plans to pledge — used only for the recap message so the user knows what to enter in the bot. Omit if the user is just exploring.

tier.description: Optional tier the user plans to pick — used only for the recap. Omit if not decided.

sol_price_usd.description: Optional SOL price for the recap quote. If omitted and collateral_usd+tier are both provided, fetched live from DexScreener.
